name: Holiday Open 2023
information: Due to available space, each competitor can only have **one guest**. Please let us know of any **concerns or special circumstances**, we may or may not be able to accomodate them. Please don't bring a guest unless you **noted so in your registration**. Let us know if you are bringing a guest if you didn't note so in your registration so we can add that. -Please review the **competitor information** tab before the competition. -Please review the **Florida/Southeast Cubing** tab for how to keep up with future competitions that are announced. -Please review **all other** tabs for more information on the competition.
